mapper.sql: n.id,n.scope_key,n.tenant_id::text,n.recipient_member_id,n.recipient_email,n.deduplication_key,n.fingerprint,n.template_id,CASE WHEN n.announcement_id IS NULL THEN n.title ELSE (SELECT a.title FROM nw_foundation_announcements a WHERE a.scope_key=n.scope_key AND a.id=n.announcement_id) END AS title,n.body,n.email_subject_cipher,CASE WHEN n.announcement_id IS NULL THEN n.email_body_cipher ELSE (SELECT a.body_cipher FROM nw_foundation_announcements a WHERE a.scope_key=n.scope_key AND a.id=n.announcement_id) END AS email_body_cipher,n.announcement_id,n.in_app,n.read_at,n.created_at

SELECT FROM nw_foundation_notifications n WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{id}
mapper.sql: n.scope_key=#{scope} AND n.recipient_member_id=#{member} AND n.in_app AND n.retired_at IS NULL AND (n.announcement_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_announcements a WHERE a.scope_key=n.scope_key AND a.id=n.announcement_id AND a.status='published' AND a.body_cipher IS NOT NULL))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM nw_foundation_notifications n WHERE AND n.id::numeric < CAST(#{cursor} AS numeric) AND n.read_at IS NULL ORDER BY n.id::numeric DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT count(*) FROM nw_foundation_notifications n WHERE AND read_at IS NULL

WITH locked AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT n.id,n.read_at FROM nw_foundation_notifications n WHERE n.id=#{id} AND FOR UPDATE OF n), changed AS (UPDATE nw_foundation_notifications n SET read_at=now() FROM locked l WHERE n.id=l.id AND l.read_at IS NULL RETURNING n.id) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM locked) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

SELECT id,scope_key,tenant_id::text,title,body_cipher,audience,recipients,status,deduplication_key,fingerprint,created_by,created_at,body_format,body_digest FROM nw_foundation_announcements WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND deduplication_key=#{key}

SELECT id,scope_key,tenant_id::text,title,body_cipher,audience,recipients,status,deduplication_key,fingerprint,created_by,created_at,body_format,body_digest FROM nw_foundation_announcements WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{id}

SELECT id,scope_key,tenant_id::text,title,body_cipher,audience,recipients,status,deduplication_key,fingerprint,created_by,created_at,body_format,body_digest FROM nw_foundation_announcements WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND retired_at IS NULL AND id::numeric < CAST(#{cursor} AS numeric) ORDER BY id::numeric DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_announcements SET status='withdrawn',withdrawn_at=now() WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{id} AND status='published'

UPDATE nw_foundation_notification_outbox o SET status='cancelled',lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,error_code='ANNOUNCEMENT_WITHDRAWN',updated_at=now() WHERE o.scope_key=#{scope} AND status IN ('pending','blocked','rejected','leased') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_notifications n WHERE n.scope_key=o.scope_key AND n.id=o.notification_id AND n.announcement_id=#{id})
mapper.select: SELECT id,scope_key,tenant_id::text,template_key,subject,body,variable_names,current,created_at FROM nw_foundation_notification_templates WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND template_key=#{key} AND current
SELECT id,scope_key,tenant_id::text,template_key,subject,body,variable_names,current,created_at FROM nw_foundation_notification_templates WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND current ORDER BY template_key
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_notification_templates SET current=false WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND template_key=#{key} AND current

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_messaging_work_scopes(scope_key) VALUES(#{scope}) ON CONFLICT(scope_key) DO UPDATE SET next_poll_at=LEAST(nw_foundation_messaging_work_scopes.next_poll_at,now())
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_notification_outbox SET status=CASE WHEN status='dispatching' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'pending' END,error_code=CASE WHEN status='dispatching' THEN 'SMTP_RESULT_UNKNOWN' ELSE 'LEASE_EXPIRED_BEFORE_DISPATCH' END,lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=now() WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND status IN ('leased','dispatching') AND lease_until<now()
mapper.select: WITH candidate AS (SELECT id FROM nw_foundation_notification_outbox WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND status='pending' ORDER BY updated_at,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) UPDATE nw_foundation_notification_outbox SET status='leased',attempts=attempts+1,lease_token=#{token},lease_until=now()+make_interval(secs=>#{leaseSeconds}),updated_at=now() WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id IN(SELECT id FROM candidate) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_notification_outbox o SET status='dispatching',updated_at=now() WHERE o.scope_key=#{scope} AND o.id=#{id} AND o.lease_token=#{token} AND o.status='leased' AND o.lease_until>now() AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_notifications n JOIN nw_foundation_announcements a ON a.scope_key=n.scope_key AND a.id=n.announcement_id WHERE n.scope_key=o.scope_key AND n.id=o.notification_id AND a.status='withdrawn')

UPDATE nw_foundation_notification_outbox SET status=#{status},error_code=#{code},lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=now() WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{id} AND lease_token=#{token} AND status IN ('leased','dispatching')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM nw_foundation_notification_outbox WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id::numeric < CAST(#{cursor} AS numeric) ORDER BY id::numeric DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM nw_foundation_notification_outbox WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_notification_outbox o SET status='pending',mailbox_id=#{mailbox},error_code=NULL,updated_at=now() WHERE o.scope_key=#{scope} AND o.id=#{id} AND status IN ('blocked','rejected') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_notifications n JOIN nw_foundation_announcements a ON a.scope_key=n.scope_key AND a.id=n.announcement_id WHERE n.scope_key=o.scope_key AND n.id=o.notification_id AND a.status='withdrawn')
UPDATE nw_foundation_notification_outbox SET status=#{status},error_code='OPERATOR_VERIFIED',updated_at=now() WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{id} AND status='unknown'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_messaging_retention(scope_key,tenant_id) VALUES(#{scope},CASE WHEN #{scope}='platform' THEN NULL ELSE substring(#{scope} from 8)::bigint END) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT retention_days FROM nw_foundation_messaging_retention WHERE scope_key=#{scope}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_messaging_retention(scope_key,tenant_id,retention_days) VALUES(#{scope},CASE WHEN #{scope}='platform' THEN NULL ELSE substring(#{scope} from 8)::bigint END,#{days}) ON CONFLICT(scope_key) DO UPDATE SET retention_days=excluded.retention_days,next_cleanup_at=now(),updated_at=now() WHERE nw_foundation_messaging_retention.retention_days IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.retention_days
mapper.select: WITH locked AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id,investigation_protected FROM nw_foundation_notifications WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND id=#{id} AND retired_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE), changed AS (UPDATE nw_foundation_notifications n SET investigation_protected=#{protect} FROM locked l WHERE n.id=l.id AND l.investigation_protected IS DISTINCT FROM #{protect} RETURNING n.id) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM changed) THEN 1 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM locked) THEN 2 ELSE 0 END
SELECT foundation_messaging_cleanup_scopes FROM foundation_messaging_cleanup_scopes()
mapper.sql: n.scope_key=#{scope} AND NOT n.investigation_protected AND n.retired_at IS NULL AND (NOT n.in_app OR n.read_at IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_announcements a WHERE a.scope_key=n.scope_key AND a.id=n.announcement_id AND a.status='withdrawn')) AND GREATEST(n.created_at,n.read_at,(SELECT a.withdrawn_at FROM nw_foundation_announcements a WHERE a.scope_key=n.scope_key AND a.id=n.announcement_id),o.updated_at)<clock_timestamp()-make_interval(days=>p.retention_days) AND (o.id IS NULL OR o.status IN('accepted','cancelled'))
mapper.delete: WITH policy AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT retention_days FROM nw_foundation_messaging_retention WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND retention_days IS NOT NULL FOR SHARE), candidates AS (SELECT a.id FROM nw_foundation_notification_attempts a JOIN nw_foundation_notification_outbox o ON o.scope_key=a.scope_key AND o.id=a.delivery_id JOIN nw_foundation_notifications n ON n.scope_key=o.scope_key AND n.id=o.notification_id,policy p WHERE a.scope_key=#{scope} AND ORDER BY a.created_at,a.id FOR UPDATE OF a SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1000) DELETE FROM nw_foundation_notification_attempts a USING candidates c WHERE a.scope_key=#{scope} AND a.id=c.id
mapper.update: WITH policy AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT retention_days FROM nw_foundation_messaging_retention WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND retention_days IS NOT NULL FOR SHARE), candidates AS (SELECT n.id FROM nw_foundation_notifications n LEFT JOIN nw_foundation_notification_outbox o ON o.scope_key=n.scope_key AND o.notification_id=n.id,policy p WHERE AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_notification_attempts a WHERE a.scope_key=o.scope_key AND a.delivery_id=o.id) ORDER BY n.created_at,n.id FOR UPDATE OF n SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 100) UPDATE nw_foundation_notifications n SET title=NULL,body=NULL,email_subject_cipher=NULL,email_body_cipher=NULL,template_id=NULL,retired_at=now() FROM candidates c WHERE n.scope_key=#{scope} AND n.id=c.id AND NOT n.investigation_protected AND n.retired_at IS NULL

WITH policy AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT retention_days FROM nw_foundation_messaging_retention WHERE scope_key=#{scope} AND retention_days IS NOT NULL FOR SHARE), candidates AS (SELECT a.id FROM nw_foundation_announcements a,policy p WHERE a.scope_key=#{scope} AND a.body_cipher IS NOT NULL AND a.created_at<clock_timestamp()-make_interval(days=>p.retention_days) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_notifications n WHERE n.scope_key=a.scope_key AND n.announcement_id=a.id AND (n.retired_at IS NULL OR n.investigation_protected)) ORDER BY a.created_at,a.id FOR UPDATE OF a SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 100) UPDATE nw_foundation_announcements a SET body_cipher=NULL,retired_at=now() FROM candidates c WHERE a.scope_key=#{scope} AND a.id=c.id AND a.body_cipher IS NOT NULL

WITH candidates AS (SELECT o.id FROM nw_foundation_notification_outbox o JOIN nw_foundation_notifications n ON n.scope_key=o.scope_key AND n.id=o.notification_id WHERE o.scope_key=#{scope} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_messaging_retention p WHERE p.scope_key=o.scope_key AND p.retention_days IS NOT NULL) AND n.retired_at IS NOT NULL AND o.status IN('accepted','cancelled') AND o.mailbox_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.updated_at,o.id FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 100) UPDATE nw_foundation_notification_outbox o SET mailbox_id=NULL FROM candidates c WHERE o.scope_key=#{scope} AND o.id=c.id AND o.mailbox_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.delete: WITH candidates AS (SELECT t.id FROM nw_foundation_notification_templates t WHERE t.scope_key=#{scope} AND NOT t.current AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_messaging_retention p WHERE p.scope_key=t.scope_key AND p.retention_days IS NOT NULL AND t.created_at<clock_timestamp()-make_interval(days=>p.retention_days)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_notifications n WHERE n.scope_key=t.scope_key AND n.template_id=t.id) ORDER BY t.created_at,t.id FOR UPDATE OF t SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 100) DELETE FROM nw_foundation_notification_templates t USING candidates c WHERE t.scope_key=#{scope} AND t.id=c.id

WITH candidates AS (SELECT m.id FROM nw_foundation_mailboxes m WHERE m.scope_key=#{scope} AND NOT m.current AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_messaging_retention p WHERE p.scope_key=m.scope_key AND p.retention_days IS NOT NULL AND m.created_at<clock_timestamp()-make_interval(days=>p.retention_days)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_notification_outbox o WHERE o.scope_key=m.scope_key AND o.mailbox_id=m.id) ORDER BY m.created_at,m.id FOR UPDATE OF m SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 100) DELETE FROM nw_foundation_mailboxes m USING candidates c WHERE m.scope_key=#{scope} AND m.id=c.id
